question_text: You are integrating GitHub with Azure Machine Learning for CI/CD. You want to automatically trigger a training pipeline whenever code is pushed to the main branch, and if the trained model's metrics exceed a threshold, automatically register it and deploy it to a staging endpoint. Which GitHub Actions workflow configuration snippet correctly uses the Azure Machine Learning CLI v2 to submit a pipeline job and check its result?

options.A:
name: Train Model
on: [push]
jobs:
  train:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: az ml job create --file pipeline.yml
      - run: az ml model register --name best_model --path outputs/model.pkl
options.B:
name: ML Pipeline
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
jobs:
  execute-pipeline:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      WORKSPACE: my-workspace
      RESOURCE_GROUP: my-rg
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: azure/login@v1
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}
      - name: Submit pipeline job
        run: az ml job create -f pipeline.yml -w $WORKSPACE -g $RESOURCE_GROUP
      - name: Get best model from run
        id: get-model
        run: |
          BEST_RUN_ID=$(az ml job list --query "[?parent_run_id=='$PARENT_RUN_ID'] | sort_by([], &metrics.accuracy) | [-1].name" -o tsv)
          az ml model create --name churn-model --path azureml://jobs/$BEST_RUN_ID/outputs/model
options.C:
name: CI/CD Pipeline
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    steps:
      - run: az ml experiment submit -c train.py
      - run: az ml endpoint create --name my-endpoint
      - run: az ml deployment create --endpoint my-endpoint --model best_model
options.D:
steps:
  - run: python train.py
  - run: az ml model deploy --name prod --model model.pkl --compute-target aci
